sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Notobasis syriaca is an annual thistle of the Mediterranean and Middle East, about 30 cm to 1.5 m tall. It grows in dry pasture, waste ground and open places.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The large, deeply divided spiny leaves often have pale veins. The 1.5–2.5 cm flower heads bear purple florets. The dry fruits are 5–6 mm long and have an outer pappus of bristles about 13–16 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: Uses of young shoots are reported in some secondary sources, but no sufficiently strong reference was found to recommend them. Toxicity is not established by the sources consulted.
